desc: Genesys International Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding copy of Newspaper Publication
Please find attached press release titled "Genesys International appoints Dhiman Basu Ray as Chief Technology Officer"

The Exchange has sought clarification from Genesys International Corporation Ltd on August 27, 2026 with reference to significant movement in price, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded.<BR><BR>The reply is awaited.
